title: Coarse rice, hand on the moustache
literal_meaning: Coarse cooked rice; a hand on the moustache.
meaning_odia: ଏପଟେ ବଗଡ଼ା ବା ମୋଟା ଚାଉଳର ଭାତ, ସେପଟେ ନିଶରେ ହାତ—ଦୁଇଟି ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ଚିତ୍ର ପାଖାପାଖି ରହିଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ସାଧାରଣ ଭୋଜନ ସହ ଗର୍ବିତ ଭଙ୍ଗୀର ମିଳନ ଦେଖାଯାଏ। କହିବାର ସ୍ୱର ଅନୁସାରେ ଏହା ବଡ଼େଇକୁ ଥଟ୍ଟା କରିପାରେ ବା ସାଧାରଣ ଅବସ୍ଥାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଆତ୍ମସମ୍ମାନ ରଖିବାକୁ ବୁଝାଇପାରେ; ମୂଳ ପଙ୍କ୍ତି ସେହି ସ୍ୱର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ କରୁନାହିଁ।
explanation: The two fragments put a plain meal beside a hand resting on a moustache. We read the gesture contextually as a proud pose. The juxtaposition can sound mocking when directed at swagger, or approving when it suggests dignity despite modest circumstances; the bare wording leaves that tone open.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Discussing a character who eats simply but carries himself proudly, readers quote the rice-and-moustache line and debate whether its tone is affectionate or teasing.
cultural_context: The rhyme joins ଭାତ and ହାତ, food and gesture. It does not describe the rice being eaten or the moustache being twirled, so the translation leaves those actions unstated.
